Diego López III de Haro: The Eldest Son of Urraca Alfonso de León and Lord of Biscay

Diego López III de Haro was the eldest son of Lope Díaz II de Haro, the illegitimate daughter of King Alfonso IX of León, and Urraca Alfonso de León, who was the daughter of King Alfonso IX of León. Diego succeeded his father as the Lord of Biscay between the years 1236 and 1254, a position he held until his death on October 4, 1254.

Diego López III de Haro played a crucial role in the politics of the region during the 13th century. He was involved in the power struggles between the Kingdom of Castile and the Kingdom of León, and his family's influence extended to the royal court of Castile.
